name: Runtime - OTEL Collector Metrics Retention
contract_reason: tmp/otel-collector/metrics.jsonl had no retention route: otel_log_retention.py defaults cover collector.err.log and collector.out.log only. The file reached 1174.5 MB (39.4% of tmp) and grows at a measured 588 MB/day. The adjacent stderr-log retention contract made the gap easy to miss, so this route is registered with drift checking rather than left implicit.
description: Daily local-only retention for tmp/otel-collector/metrics.jsonl. Rotates the live file when it exceeds 256 MB, gzips archives (measured 13.19x on real data), prunes by a 60-day window with a 4096 MB hard budget, and restarts the local loopback collector to release its file handle. Peak live file is ~844 MB at the measured rate; 60-day compressed history is ~2.6 GB. No collector-config mutation, external export, raw content capture, cron/schedule mutation, finance/canon/capital, or execution authority.
contract_update_reason: Initial registration after owner-approved retention. Owner approved daily cadence, gzip archives, and a 60-day window after measurement showed the original weekly proposal could not hold target size at 588 MB/day (weekly peak would have been ~4.4 GB). Records the live job as created; adds no scheduler, config, or runtime mutation beyond the approved job itself.
